facts.fact: 她一路狂奔穿过半座被炸毁的城奔向海边，心里只有「现在」和「赶到他身边」
facts.anchor: All that was in Valentina’s mind was now – this moment, and getting to him

facts.fact: 她躲着瓦砾跑，小腿被撞出血也没有察觉
facts.anchor: she was dodging rubble. This street had been decimated by the raids

facts.fact: 修女院资助私掠远征抽成的事让她神往，幻想自己有钱创业、让男人承认她的精明
facts.anchor: Valentina had always enjoyed this notion of women financing men to do their dirty work

facts.fact: Lawrenz 曾说她满脑子历史没有女孩样，却仍只因她的长相想要她
facts.anchor: Lawrenz had told her as much, and still his dull brain wanted her simply because of how she looked

facts.fact: 她 8 岁时在电影院见过 Mae West 电影片段，那句台词后来逗笑过飞行员
facts.anchor: She’d arrived right when Mae West’s character had uttered the famous line

facts.fact: 她不由自主俯身吻了飞行员沾血的额头，引来周围女人惊呼
facts.anchor: she bent and kissed his blood-streaked forehead

facts.fact: 她确认自己爱上了这个英俊飞行员，哪怕他已经死了
facts.anchor: She already knew she was in love with the handsome pilot, even if he was dead

facts.fact: 她握住他死去的手指，为奇迹祈祷
facts.anchor: cast a prayer for a miracle
